items.headline: Overcomes turnovers in win
items.text: Daniels completed 23 of 33 passes for 249 yards with three touchdowns and two interceptions and rushed 11 times for 28 yards in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

items.headline: Career-high receiving yardage tally in win
items.text: McCaffrey rushed 13 times for 62 yards and a touchdown and brought in all four targets for 161 yards and two more scores in the 49ers' 46-40 win over the Cowboys on Sunday. He also caught a two-point conversion pass.

items.headline: Stymied by Bengals in loss
items.text: Warren rushed seven times for 15 yards and brought in five of six targets for 26 yards in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday night. He committed a fumble recovered by Pittsburgh.

items.headline: Records game-winning TD in victory
items.text: Diggs secured six of 10 targets for 83 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

items.headline: Career-high totals in return
items.text: Pickens brought in 11 of 18 targets for 145 yards and three touchdowns in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.

items.headline: Cleared for Week 11
items.text: Kelce (ankle/calf) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.

items.headline: Makes little impact in return
items.text: Etienne carried the ball eight times for 14 yards and caught three of five targets for 20 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.

items.headline: Totals 66 yards, TD behind CMC
items.text: Black rushed 11 times for 53 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 46-40 win over the Cowboys. He added two catches for 13 yards on two targets.

items.headline: Gets doubtful tag
items.text: Kincaid (thumb/ankle) is listed as doubtful for Sunday's game against the Dolphins, Matt Parrino reports.

items.headline: Cleared of head injury
items.text: Head coach Kevin Stefanski said Monday that London was cleared of a concussion near the end of Sunday's 35-13 loss to the Chiefs, Will McFadden of the Falcons' official site reports.

items.headline: Ditches protective glove on left hand
items.text: Shough is no longer wearing a protect glove on his left (non-throwing) hand at Thursday's practice, Nick Underhill of NewOrleans.Football reports.

items.headline: Cleared for Week 11
items.text: Rodriguez (hand) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.

items.headline: Has thumb surgery, avoiding IR
items.text: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Wednesday that Addison underwent thumb surgery earlier this week and won't be placed on injured reserve, Alec Lewis of The Athletic reports.

items.headline: Two more TD passes
items.text: Rodgers completed 15 of 29 passes for 143 yards, two touchdowns and no interceptions and rushed two times for minus-1 yard during Sunday's 38-18 loss at Cincinnati.

items.headline: Season-best effort in win
items.text: Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.headline: Spectacular night in win
items.text: Chase brought in 11 of 14 targets for 231 yards in the Bengals' 38-18 win over the Steelers on Sunday night. He also committed a fumble that stayed with Cincinnati.

items.headline: Expected to be available Sunday
items.text: McConkey (back) is expected to play in Sunday's game against the Jets, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.

items.headline: Leading receiver in loss to Jags
items.text: Ayomanor caught five of 10 targets for 79 yards in Sunday's 40-23 loss to the Jaguars.

items.headline: Ticketed for lead-back duties again
items.text: With Kenneth Walker (groin) ruled out for Sunday's game against the Cardinals, Johnson is in line to handle workhorse duties for the second straight week, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

items.headline: First TD of career
items.text: Price posted nine carries for 36 yards and one touchdown and gathered in his only target for eight yards during Sunday's 21-13 victory at Las Vegas.

items.headline: Impressive numbers in loss
items.text: McCarthy completed 23 of 36 passes for 293 yards with a touchdown and an interception while adding six rushes for 34 yards in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

items.headline: Career-best yardage total in win
items.text: Harris secured all five targets for 86 yards in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.

items.headline: Expected to return for MNF
items.text: Croskey-Merritt (groin) is slated to be activated from IR in time to play in Monday's game against the Bengals, Matt Zenitz of CBS Sports reports.

items.headline: Trending toward Week 12 return
items.text: Head coach Mike Macdonald said Monday that he's "really optimistic" Darnold (quadriceps/ribs) will be able to get a full week's worth of practice coming out of the Seahawks' Week 11 bye and start their next game Sunday, Nov. 29, against the 49ers, John Boyle of the team's official site reports.

items.headline: Finds end zone in Carolina
items.text: Coleman carried the ball 17 times for 57 yards and a touchdown and caught all four of his targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.

items.headline: Will play Sunday
items.text: Douglas (shoulder) will play Sunday against the Bills, David Furones of the South Florida Sun Sentinel reports.

items.headline: Good to go for Week 11
items.text: Hockenson (wrist) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday night's game against the 49ers.

items.headline: Notches first TD in Week 9 win
items.text: Odunze caught four of seven targets for 60 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers.

items.headline: Good to go for Sunday's game
items.text: Waddle (concussion) doesn't carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Raiders after practicing fully this week.

items.headline: Questionable for Monday
items.text: White (heel) is listed as questionable for Monday's game versus the Bengals.

items.headline: Paces pass catchers in win
items.text: Fannin brought in seven of nine targets for 91 yards in the Browns' 27-24 win over the Texans on Sunday.

items.headline: Modest numbers in loss to Lions
items.text: Kiner carried the ball 10 times for 25 yards in Sunday's 35-10 loss to Detroit.

items.headline: Ties career high with five TDs in loss
items.text: Prescott completed 30 of 51 passes for 343 yards with five touchdowns and one interception while rushing four times for seven yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday. He also ran for a two-point conversion.

items.headline: Productive with 24 touches
items.text: Gordon rushed 20 times for 76 and brought in four of five targets for 39 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.

items.headline: Welcoming back Monangai
items.text: Swift will be rejoined in the Bears backfield by Kyle Monangai (toe) on Sunday against the Saints, Larry Mayer of the team's official site reports.

items.headline: Solid night marred by key fumble
items.text: Flowers brought in six of seven targets for 74 yards and lost a fumble in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday night.

items.headline: Nine catches in reunion with Cousins
items.text: Jefferson caught nine of 13 targets for 74 yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.

items.headline: Gets into end zone in loss
items.text: Metcalf brought in two of six targets for 54 yards and a touchdown and added a two-point conversion catch in the Steelers' 38-18 loss to the Bengals on Sunday night.

items.headline: Good to go for Week 11
items.text: Meyers (ankle) doesn't have an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.

items.headline: Keeps piling up TDs in win
items.text: Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.headline: Tosses three TDs in Munich
items.text: Goff completed 20 of 31 passes for 303 yards and three touchdowns with two interceptions in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich. He added three yards on his only carry.

items.headline: Solid numbers in blowout loss
items.text: Robinson rushed 16 times for 71 yards and a touchdown and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: Shut down by Minnesota
items.text: Kraft caught one of four targets for 19 yards in Sunday's 30-10 loss to the Vikings.

items.headline: Struggles in Week 10 loss
items.text: Stevenson carried the ball six times for four yards and caught his only target for one yard in Sunday's 35-10 loss to the Lions in Munich.

items.headline: Without clear timeline for return
items.text: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that he has no new updates on the status of Conner (foot), who is still "working to return to perform," Tyler Drake of ArizonaSports.com reports. "It was not a good injury," LaFleur said.

items.headline: Efficient in first win of season
items.text: Herbert completed 12 of 18 passes for 129 yards with no touchdowns or interceptions and rushed seven times for 51 yards and a touchdown in the Chargers' 23-20 win over the Ravens on Monday night.

items.headline: Cleared for Sunday's game
items.text: Tuten (ankle/foot) doesn't carry an injury designation for Sunday's game against the Giants.

items.headline: Productive with five catches in win
items.text: Rice brought in five of six targets for 82 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: Tallies 120 all-purpose yards in loss
items.text: Washington secured all three targets for 50 yards, threw a 34-yard touchdown on his one pass attempt and returned four punts for 36 yards in the Dolphins' 24-22 loss to the Colts on Sunday.

items.headline: Season-best effort in Brissett's debut
items.text: Andrews brought in all eight targets for 82 yards in the Ravens' 23-20 loss to the Chargers on Monday.

items.headline: Hits paydirt in Green Bay
items.text: Jones carried the ball 11 times for 47 yards and a touchdown and caught his only target for eight yards in Sunday's 30-10 win over the Packers.

items.headline: Three catches in Week 11 win
items.text: Dell secured three of four targets for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.headline: Five-TD day in win
items.text: Mahomes completed 22 of 35 passes for 348 yards with five touchdowns and no interceptions while adding two rushes for 15 yards in the Chiefs' 35-13 win over the Falcons on Sunday.

items.headline: In clear for Week 11 action
items.text: Barkley (hamstring) told EJ Smith of PHLY Sports on Friday that he "feels better physically" after the team's Week 10 bye, and the running back doesn't have a designation for Sunday's contest against the Steelers.

items.headline: Five touches in victory
items.text: Dobbins rushed four times for 18 yards and caught his only target for four yards during Sunday's 26-21 win over Carolina.

items.headline: Goose egg in Week 10 win
items.text: Coker failed to catch any of his four targets in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Saints.

items.headline: Two trips to end zone in Week 10 win
items.text: St. Brown caught four of five targets for 98 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots in Munich.

items.headline: Overshadowed by rookie in Week 10 loss
items.text: Olave caught three of four targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Panthers.

items.headline: Good yardage on one catch
items.text: Warren brought in one of five targets for 22 yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.

items.headline: Middling production in Week 10 loss
items.text: Nabers secured five of seven targets for 44 yards and lost a fumble in the Giants' 24-21 loss to the Commanders on Thursday.

items.headline: Tosses three TDs in big win
items.text: Lawrence completed 25 of 35 passes for 352 yards and three touchdowns with one interception in Sunday's 40-23 win over the Titans. He added 27 yards on four carries.

items.headline: Massive numbers in Week 10 romp
items.text: Gibbs carried the ball 22 times for 153 yards and two touchdowns while catching seven of eight targets for 99 yards in Sunday's 35-10 win over the Patriots.

items.headline: Still viewed as Jets' top backfield option
items.text: Head coach Aaron Glenn told reporters Friday that Hall could see a bump in touches for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Howie Kussoy of the New York Post reports.

items.headline: Scores 45-yard TD in Week 10 win
items.text: Moore caught four of six targets for 90 yards and a touchdown while rushing once for four yards in Sunday's 31-12 win over the Jets.

items.headline: Logs full practice Thursday
items.text: Smith (hamstring) practiced fully Thursday.

items.headline: Not much on five touches in Week 10
items.text: Allgeier mustered five carries for 14 yards and didn't gather in his only target during Sunday's 34-6 defeat to the Rams.

items.headline: Solid with 17 touches Sunday
items.text: Williams rushed 16 times for 63 yards and brought in his only target for four yards in the Cowboys' 46-40 loss to the 49ers on Sunday.

items.headline: Finds end zone in Week 10 win
items.text: Williams secured both targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Commanders' 24-21 win over the Giants on Thursday.

items.headline: Cashes in TD in Week 9 win
items.text: Sutton caught five of nine targets for 45 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 26-21 win over the Panthers.

items.headline: Sets up winning FG with 38-yard grab
items.text: Loveland caught four of six targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 27-24 win over the Buccaneers.

items.headline: May have workload managed after bye
items.text: Head coach Todd Bowles said Monday that the Buccaneers "will try and lessen the load" on Irving following their Week 10 bye, Rick Stroud of the Tampa Bay Times reports.

items.headline: Retaining starting job
items.text: Head coach Nick Sirianni confirmed that Milton will remain the Eagles' starting quarterback for Sunday's game against the Steelers, according to NFL reporter Andrew Siciliano .
